about.label: // biography
about.title: About me
about.bio1: Hi, I'm Sinver Aguiló, a Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience building web platforms that scale to meet the demands of their users. I currently lead the frontend of PSM, a national government platform for Burocracia Cero / CNC in the Dominican Republic, where our work has driven a roughly 4x improvement in request-processing throughput.
about.bio2: My expertise spans React, Next.js and Vue.js on the frontend, and full-stack work with Node.js and PHP on the backend. I've led architecture for large legacy migrations — from monolithic .NET, Rails and JSP applications to modern client-server and microservices structures, for products like Corotos, NZXT and Crunchyroll — and I care deeply about accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), internationalization, and CI/CD with Docker and GitHub Actions.
about.bio3: Throughout my career I've been committed to doing things the right way and getting things done. I bring architecture ownership, mentorship and a results-driven approach to every team I join. I'm based in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, open to remote work, and fluent in English (C1).
